title: Pay growth by percentile, 2019 to 2026 Q2: UK vs US
source: HMRC PAYE Real Time Information (ONS); BLS Current Population Survey via FRED; ONS CPI; BLS CPI-U; ukmacro calculations
note: UK: monthly pay of all payrolled employees (full and part time), HMRC PAYE RTI. US: usual weekly earnings of full-time wage and salary workers, CPS. Both seasonally adjusted. Coverage differs, so compare growth, not levels. Deflated by UK CPI and US CPI-U.
